title: Mayor Owens Launches the "Lead Big Table"
summary: Mayor Sharon Owens launched the Lead Big Table on National Lead Poisoning Prevention Week, a multi-agency collaborative initiative modeled after the successful I-81 Big Table structure. The effort coordinates government agencies, health experts, housing partners, educators, and community organizations to address lead hazards in housing, pipes, and dust—with explicit focus on racial equity given that Black children in Onondaga County face nearly six times higher lead exposure risk than white children.

political_signal.description: Mayor's leadership signals city commitment to environmental health equity; explicit acknowledgment of racial disparities in lead exposure and partnership with civil rights organizations demonstrates alignment with social justice priorities.
